Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added Gear section focus to the main AutoBuy window. AutoBuy can now focus one armoury section across all enabled keyword groups, such as Rings for Rinascita/Classical or Main Hand for Diadoch/Ceremonial. All sections remains the default.
